notes: Mechanical values (influenceCost / advance / favorToCounter / stage / condition / effect) transcribed from Sauron_Plots.pdf; they matched the prior card-scan data.
marker colour is from the card token icon (ring=>yellow, eye/crest=>red, horned skull=>black); markerName maps yellow=Ring, red=Military, black=Corruption.
aiLocDifficulty / aiReqEase / aiEffectVal are the Lidless Eye bot's 0-4 priority ratings from the PDF (location difficulty for heroes, ease of the play requirement, value of the effect).

eventDeckPlot plots (Of Serpents and Sand, The Glades of Orthanc Darken, The Blood of Rhun, Dark News from Erebor) enter via the stage event deck; each places a character and advances its story marker 1 space every Story Step until explored/discarded (marker colours confirmed from MEQ_Eventcards_Fulltext).
Shadow cards affecting plots and 'Other Ways to Advance Story Markers' are captured in _meta.rules below.

shadowCardsAffectingPlots.name: Saruman's Lies
shadowCardsAffectingPlots.text: Look at the top card of the plot deck; place it on the top or bottom of the deck. Then, if any hero has corruption cards >= his wisdom, advance the black (Corruption) story marker one space.

shadowCardsAffectingPlots.name: Ithil Stone
shadowCardsAffectingPlots.text: Retrieve and hold or immediately play the 'Denethor Falls into Madness' or 'Saruman Falls to Corruption' plot card.

shadowCardsAffectingPlots.name: Shire, Baggins
shadowCardsAffectingPlots.text: Place one influence in the Shadow Pool and one in the Shire. Then, if you have at least three influence or a minion in the Shire, advance the yellow (Ring) story marker two spaces.

shadowCardsAffectingPlots.name: Lord of the Rings
shadowCardsAffectingPlots.text: Choose a discarded plot or shadow card from the discard pile, show it to the heroes, and place it in your hand. Then, if 'A Dark Messenger' is active, advance the yellow (Ring) story marker one space.

otherWaysToAdvanceMarkers: When heroes rest/heal, advance the lowest Sauron marker one space.
One corruption card allows Sauron to advance his lowest story marker two spaces (instead of one) when heroes rest/heal.
One peril card forces the hero to allow Sauron to advance his black story marker one space or pay a penalty.

plots.name: Sauron Hunts for the Ring
plots.effect: Setup: 2 influence in each Shadow Stronghold, 7 in extension, 1 in the Shadow Pool; keep 1 of 2 Shadow cards; keep 2 of 5 Plot cards.

plots.name: Monsters in the East
plots.effect: Setup: 2 influence in each Shadow Stronghold, 9 in extension; keep 1 of 3 Shadow cards; keep 2 of 3 Plot cards.

plots.name: Saruman Hungry for Power
plots.effect: Setup: 3 influence in each Shadow Stronghold, 3 in extension, 2 in the Shadow Pool; keep 2 of 3 Shadow cards; keep 2 of 4 Plot cards.

plots.name: A Dark Messenger
plots.effect: When a hero consults Dain II, he gains 1 Corruption.

plots.name: Gollum is Captured
plots.effect: Discard all other active Plot cards with 'Gollum' in the title.

plots.name: Saruman Falls to Corruption
plots.effect: Isengard becomes perilous; when a hero consults Saruman he gains 1 Corruption.

plots.name: Wormtongue Taints Theoden
plots.condition: 6 influence within 1 space of Edoras, or 'Saruman Falls to Corruption' active.
plots.effect: When a hero consults Theoden he gains 1 Corruption.

plots.name: Denethor Falls into Madness
plots.effect: When a hero consults Denethor he gains 1 Corruption.

plots.name: Orcs in the Mountains
plots.condition: 8 influence within 1 space of Mount Gundabad.

plots.name: A Broken Line of Kings
plots.affectsText: A Haven (Sauron's choice) with no plot marker and 6+ influence adjacent.
plots.condition: 6 influence adjacent to a Haven containing no other plot marker.
plots.effect: Heroes may not rest in or draw encounter cards in the affected haven.

plots.name: A Broken Line of Kings
plots.affectsText: A Haven (Sauron's choice) with no plot marker and 6+ influence adjacent.
plots.condition: 6 influence adjacent to a Haven containing no other plot marker.
plots.effect: Heroes may not rest in or draw encounter cards in the affected haven.

plots.name: Gollum is Tortured
plots.effect: Discard all other active Plot cards with 'Gollum' in the title.

plots.name: Smeagol Escapes
plots.condition: A monster token or minion within 1 space of the Woodland Realm.
plots.effect: When active, retrieve 1 'Gollum' Plot card from your deck or discard pile, then shuffle.

plots.name: Loss of an Heir
plots.condition: A monster token or minion within 1 space of the affected location.

plots.name: A Promise of Rings
plots.affectsText: A location (Sauron's choice) with a character token and at least 1 monster token or minion.
plots.condition: Location must contain one character and one monster token or minion.

plots.name: Rise of the Uruk-hai
plots.condition: 3 influence in Isengard, or 'Saruman Falls to Corruption' active.
plots.effect: Sauron may treat any non-blank monster tokens in the Rohan region as Uruk-hai.

plots.name: Urgent Summons
plots.affectsText: A location (Sauron's choice) with a character token and no plot marker.
plots.condition: Location must contain one character and no other plot markers.
plots.effect: When active, return all character tokens on the location to the Favor and Character area.

plots.name: Of Serpents and Sand

plots.effect: While in play, advance the Red (Military) story marker 1 space each Story Step. Explore to discard.

plots.name: Dark News from Erebor

plots.effect: While in play, advance the Black (Corruption) story marker 1 space each Story Step. Explore to discard.
